title: MSD Proinflammatory Cytokine Panel 1 (Mouse) Kit
author: Aisha Sati
materials: Electronic plate reader (MSD Meso QuickPlex SQ 120MM)
STEP 2: Wash and Add Detection Antibody Solution

Follow kit instruction to prepare 7 calibrator solutions plus a zero calibrator for up to 4 replicates: -Prepare the highest calibrator (Calibrator 1) by adding 1000 µL of Diluent 41 to the lyophilized calibrator vial. -After reconstituting, invert at least 3 times (do not vortex). -Let the reconstituted solution equilibrate at Room temperature for 00:15:00 - 00:30:00 -Vortex briefly using short pulses.

steps.title: Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Dilute samples using Diluent 41 based on sample type.

substeps.instruction: For mouse CSF, use a 2-fold dilution.
For primary microglia culture supernatants, use a 5-fold dilution.

steps.title: Prepare Calibrators
steps.instruction: Generate a 7-point calibration curve using Diluent 41.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the first dilution by transferring 100 µL of the highest calibrator to 300 µL of Diluent 41.
Mix well by vortexing.
Repeat 4-fold serial dilutions 5 additional times to generate 7 calibrators.
Use Diluent 41 as the zero calibrator.

steps.title: Add Samples and Calibrators
steps.instruction: Load the plate with samples and calibrators and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of prepared samples and calibrators per well.
Seal the plate with an adhesive plate seal.
Incubate at Room temperature with shaking for 02:00:00.

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Wash the plate to remove unbound materials.

substeps.instruction: Wash the plate 3 times with at least 150 µL/well of Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Detection Antibody Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the 1X working solution immediately before use by combining 50X stock antibodies in 2400 µL of Diluent 45.

substeps.instruction: Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms IFN- Antibody
Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms IL-1 Antibody
Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms IL-2 Antibody
Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms IL-4 Antibody
Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms IL-5 Antibody
Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms IL-6 Antibody
Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms KC/GRO Antibody
Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms IL-10 Antibody
Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms IL-12p70 Antibody
Add 60 µL of SULFO-TAG Anti-ms TNF- Antibody

steps.title: Add Detection Antibody
steps.instruction: Apply the detection antibody solution to the plate and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µL of detection antibody solution to each well.
Seal the plate with an adhesive plate seal.
Incubate at Room temperature with shaking for 02:00:00.

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Wash the plate to remove unbound detection antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Wash the plate 3 times with at least 150 µL/well of Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Read Plate
steps.instruction: Add read buffer and analyze the plate using an MSD instrument.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL of Read Buffer to each well.
Read plate on electronic plate reader (MSD Meso QuickPlex SQ 120MM) using methodical mind software.
Note: Incubation in Read Buffer is not required before reading.
